units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 3) by decision of the head of the higher body in cases concerning violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules resulting in minor or moderate harm to the victim’s health — for a period of up to six months;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 4) by decision of the head of the higher body in cases concerning unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling — for a period of up to six months;
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 5) by decision of the head of the higher prosecutor’s office in cases concerning unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity — for a period of up to twelve months in cases connected with execution of a request for legal assistance sent in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.1.1 of this Code.
units.label: Point 5 Part 5 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 5.1. The decision to extend the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall be taken in the form of a procedural order. The procedural order extending the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew it up, the grounds for extending the period for conducting the administrative investigation, and the date until which the administrative investigation is extended. The procedural order extending the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall be signed by the head or deputy head who issued it in accordance with part 5 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 5.2. A copy of the procedural order extending the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall, within twenty-four hours, be handed against acknowledgement of receipt or sent to the individual or legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom the administrative investigation is being conducted, and to the victim.
units.label: Part 5.2 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 6. Upon completion of an administrative investigation, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up or a ruling terminating the administrative offence case shall be issued.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. The administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) and other materials of the administrative offence case shall be sent to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case within three days from the moment the administrative offence record is drawn up (the ruling is issued).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. An administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) concerning an offence for which an administrative fine is provided, sent to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case, shall be accompanied by the information required under the rules for completing payment documents for transfer of the amount of an administrative fine provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the national payment system, indicating the unique charge identifier.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.2. The administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) and other materials of the administrative offence case, together with an application to impose administrative liability signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, shall be sent to the court through the electronic document management system of the body whose official is specified in part 1.5 of this Article, in the form of electronic documents, including in machine-readable form, where the judge and body have the technical capability.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.3. The application to impose administrative liability shall specify:
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) the name of the court to which the application to impose administrative liability is sent;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) the position, surname and initials of the official sending the application to impose administrative liability to the court;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) the postal address for sending documents to the body whose official sends the application to impose administrative liability, and information on the possibility of sending documents to that body using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) the telephone numbers of the official and body specified in points 2 and 3 of this part, and their fax numbers and email addresses (if available);
units.label: Point 4 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) the position, surname and initials of the official (prosecutor) who drew up the administrative offence record (issued the ruling);
units.label: Point 5 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) the postal address for sending documents to the body whose official initiated the administrative offence case, and information on the possibility of sending documents using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) the telephone numbers of the official and body specified in points 5 and 6 of this part, and their fax numbers and email addresses (if available);
units.label: Point 7 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 8) particulars of the person in respect of whom the administrative offence record was drawn up (the prosecutor’s ruling was issued):
units.label: Point 8 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: а) for citizens and officials — surname, first name and patronymic (if any), date of birth, place of residence or stay, information on the possibility of sending that person notices and documents by the methods specified in part 2 of Article 24.9 and part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, and, in the absence of such information, the postal address for sending notices and documents if it differs from the address of the place of residence or stay;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 8 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: б) for legal entities — name, address specified in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities, date of state registration as a legal entity, primary state registration number, information on the possibility of sending that entity notices and documents by the methods specified in part 2 of Article 24.9 and part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, and, in the absence of such information, the postal address for sending notices and documents if it differs from the address specified in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 8 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 9) the date, time and place of the actions (inaction) that served as grounds for drawing up the administrative offence record;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 10) the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for commission of the administrative offence;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 11) other information material to resolving the case;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 12) the demand to impose administrative liability on the person in respect of whom the administrative offence record was drawn up (the prosecutor’s ruling was issued);
units.label: Point 12 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 13) a list of attached documents.
units.label: Point 13 Part 1.3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.4. The information provided for by points 6 and 7 of part 1.3 of this Article shall be stated in the application to impose administrative liability where it differs from the information provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 1.3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1.4 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.5. The application to impose administrative liability shall be signed and sent by the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up an administrative offence record.
units.label: Part 1.5 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.6. Where the technical capability is absent, the administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) and other materials of the administrative offence case, together with the application to impose administrative liability, shall be sent to the court by post or handed to authorised court staff against acknowledgement of receipt.
units.label: Part 1.6 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Copies of the procedural documents specified in part 1 of Article 24.9 of this Code that are produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, and form part of the materials of the administrative offence case shall be made by converting those electronic documents into paper documents and certified in the established manner.
units.label: Part 1.6 Art. 28.8 · “Copies of the procedural documents specified in part 1 of…”

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.7. The following, if available, shall be attached to a record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code sent to the judge authorised to consider the administrative offence case:
units.label: Part 1.7 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) materials of a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code, initiated against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction) by the body whose official drew up the record specified in the first paragraph of this part, except in the cases provided for by points 2 and 3 of this part;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1.7 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) materials of a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code in which the body whose official drew up the record specified in the first paragraph of this part issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction);
units.label: Point 2 Part 1.7 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) information on forwarding to another judge the materials of a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code, initiated against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction) by the body whose official drew up the record specified in the first paragraph of this part, or on a judge’s issuance of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty for commission of that administrative offence.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1.7 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. The administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) concerning an offence entailing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be forwarded for consideration to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case immediately after it is drawn up (issued).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Where an administrative offence record has been drawn up by an unauthorised person, and in other cases provided for by point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code, deficiencies in the record and other materials of the administrative offence case shall be remedied within no more than three days from the day they arrive (are received) from the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case. The materials of the administrative offence case, with amendments and additions made to them, shall be returned to that judge, body or official within twenty-four hours from the day the relevant deficiencies are remedied.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. Where a measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case in the form of a temporary prohibition of activity has been applied, the administrative offence record concerning an offence for which an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activity may be imposed, and the record of temporary prohibition of activity, shall be forwarded for consideration to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case immediately after they are drawn up.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.8

units.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.9

units.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.9

units.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Where at least one of the circumstances listed in Article 24.5 of this Code exists, the body or official handling the administrative offence case shall issue a ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case in compliance with the requirements provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.9

units.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. A ruling terminating proceedings in an administrative offence case on the ground provided for by part 2 of Article 24.5 of this Code, together with all case materials, shall, within twenty-four hours from the moment the ruling is issued, be sent to the military unit, body or institution at the place of military service (service) or military training of the person who committed the administrative offence, so that the person may be held disciplinarily liable.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.9

units.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code shall be terminated by the Bank of Russia no later than five days after the day on which the Bank of Russia adopts a decision recognising the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code as fulfilled.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.9

units.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. The body or official handling an administrative offence case that was suspended on the basis of a motion by the command of a military unit (institution) shall, upon receipt from authorised bodies of information on the circumstances provided for by part 4 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code, issue a ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case in compliance with the requirements provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.9

units.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. In the case provided for by point 5.2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall be terminated by the body or official handling the administrative offence case no later than five days after the day on which a decision is adopted recognising the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code as fulfilled.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.9

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Where a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code concludes the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code, proceedings in that administrative offence case shall be suspended from the day following the day that agreement enters into force, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Where a person fails to perform the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code, the Bank of Russia shall resume proceedings in the administrative offence case from the day following the day a decision is adopted recognising that agreement with the Bank of Russia as unfulfilled, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Upon receipt of a motion by the command of a military unit (institution), proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 9.3 or Chapter 12 of this Code, where the sanction of the applicable Article provides for deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle of the relevant type or other types of equipment, shall be suspended in relation to a service member performing military service during mobilisation, martial law or wartime, or a person in a volunteer formation, who is engaged to carry out tasks of the special military operation, from the day that motion is received, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued. The procedure for interaction on suspension of proceedings in that case shall be determined in accordance with part 6 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. If, during a person’s military service or presence in a volunteer formation, a new ruling imposing an administrative penalty on that person in the form of deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle of the relevant type or other types of equipment, provided for by Article 9.3 or Chapter 12 of this Code, enters into legal force, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall resume from the day following the day the new ruling enters into legal force, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. Where a person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are being conducted concludes the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code, proceedings in that administrative offence case shall be suspended from the day following the day that agreement enters into force, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. Where a person fails to perform the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code, the body or official shall resume proceedings in the administrative offence case from the day following the day a decision is adopted recognising that agreement as unfulfilled, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7. A copy of the procedural order provided for by part 5 or 6 of this Article shall be sent to the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted within three days from the day the procedural order is issued.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 28.10

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: In preparing to consider an administrative offence case, the judge, body or official shall ascertain the following:
units.label: Art. 29.1 · “In preparing to consider an administrative offence case, the…”

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) whether consideration of the case falls within their competence;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) whether there are circumstances precluding consideration of the case by the judge, a member of the collegial body or the official;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) whether the administrative offence record and other records provided for by this Code have been correctly drawn up, and whether the other case materials have been properly prepared;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) whether there are circumstances precluding proceedings in the case;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) whether the available case materials are sufficient to consider it on the merits;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 29.1
